scripts.audit:tennis:repair-certified-results: node -e "require('./backend/paperTrading.tennis.js'); const path=require('path'); const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); const db=new Database(path.join('backend','database_betting.db')); const paper=require('./backend/paperTrading.tennis.js'); const rows=db.prepare(\`SELECT * FROM ai_forward_test WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(sport_type,''))='TENNIS' OR UPPER(COALESCE(bet_type,'')) LIKE '%TENNIS%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(strategy_tag,'')) LIKE '%TENNIS%'\`).all(); let n=0; for (const r of rows){ const res=paper.step107BuildCertifiedResolution(r); if(!res) continue; const evalRes=paper.evaluateTennisBet(r.prediction,res.winner,res.totalGames); if(evalRes===null) continue; const status=evalRes===true?'WON':evalRes===false?'LOST':evalRes; const stake=Number(r.stake)||0; const odd=Number(r.odd)||0; const profit=status==='WON'?Number((stake*(odd-1)).toFixed(2)):status==='LOST'?-stake:0; db.prepare(\`UPDATE ai_forward_test SET status=?, profit=?, settlement_source=?, settlement_note=?, settled_at=?, total_games=?, winner_side=?, winner_player_name=?, predicted_player_name=COALESCE(predicted_player_name, CASE WHEN prediction='1' THEN home_team WHEN prediction='2' THEN away_team ELSE predicted_player_name END), side_mapping_verified=1, side_identity_version=? WHERE id=?\`).run(status, profit, res.source, res.note, new Date().toISOString(), res.totalGames, res.winner, res.winnerName||res.winner_player_name, paper.STEP107_TENNIS_SIDE_IDENTITY_CERTIFIED_RESULTS_REPAIR, r.id); n++; } console.log(JSON.stringify({success:true, repaired:n, step:'STEP107'},null,2));"
